name: iacg-code
purpose: Show the exact generated .tf files for a mission so the user can explore the code, on demand.
never_do: invent or paraphrase the code (show exact file bytes)
run apply or modify files when asked only to view
hide a .tf file because it is short

provenance.source_reference: Owner directive I4: the mission shows a tree path but the user cannot see the code; surface the generated .tf on demand.
